nativeInterface.testDocument: Controlled embedded HTML in an actual AppKit window and production RcloneWebView
coverage: Native background and zoom before document loading
Document-start saved dark theme and subsequent light-theme document
Five standard and two retained legacy zoom values with pane hit testing
Actual NSEvent delivery through production NSWindow.sendEvent to WebKit receipts
Paired presses, release-only, duplicate dispatch, rapid presses, and missing releases
AppKit decoding and runtime application of three ICNS icons

knownSkip.reason: Linux inotify is unavailable on macOS; portable NAS transfer and comparison cases still execute.

compatibilityScope.packagedUI: Windows uses an NSIS-installed executable; Linux extracts the DEB and runs its packaged executable under Xvfb.
compatibilityScope.initialTheme: Saved green-dark is applied before the production interface initializes.
compatibilityScope.zoom: New 100% starts at 0.90, changes to 125% at 1.15, and restores the original viewport at 100%.
compatibilityScope.runtime: Bundled Swift runtime, with build SDK runtime paths removed from smoke environment.
